answer: Nebula-linked escrow wallets. Each agent identity must hold a small jade deposit locked to a slow-release schedule; cloning forces the attacker to fund and lock one deposit per clone for months before any payout. A trellis of cross-agent settlement records ties each identity to real transaction history, so fresh clones cannot withdraw earnings until the escrow matures. Attacker cost: N escrow deposits plus N months of idle capital.
